I did not run a causal-discovery test. I picked B from the physical relationship and a quick correlation check.

The two residuals are clearly related, with a correlation of about 0.53. Correlation alone doesn't give a direction, so option D (no causal relationship) is ruled out but A versus B isn't settled by the data.

Cloud water path is a grid-mean quantity. More cloud cover means more cloudy area and so more total cloud water, which points to cover driving water. The reverse effect exists but is weaker, so I ruled out the two-sided option C.

ANSWER: B
